issues.legal_issue: A criminal proceeding may be quashed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure when a civil dispute is given a criminal colour to exert pressure and continuation would amount to an abuse of process.

The mere invocation of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act does not bar the exercise of inherent powers to quash proceedings where the allegations disclose no offence under that Act.
Police officers must assess whether the facts prima facie justify invoking a stringent statutory provision and must not apply it mechanically.
